GameSir Pocket Taco is a vertical phone controller that turns your smartphone into a retro-style handheld.

Kickstarter: https://bit.ly/kkgspt1
Official website: https://bit.ly/pockettaco1

Here’s a first look + real testing, including the GameSir app features that make it way more customizable than it looks.
In this video, I go hands-on with the Pocket Taco—a compact Bluetooth controller designed for vertical retro gaming on mobile. It clamps onto your phone, connects wirelessly, and even leaves access to your charging port so you can power up while you play.
